environment.description: ECS Fargate service running behind an Application Load Balancer with default configuration. Container runs on port 8080, ALB forwards traffic on port 443 with TLS termination. Session cookies are set without SameSite attribute (Flask default before 2.3.0 is None without Secure). No additional middleware or CDN protections. Task definition uses awsvpc networking mode with public subnet placement.

config.alb_config: default listener rules, no WAF attached
